ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low white-to-black ratio; approximately 98% low-intensity (dark grey/black) to 2% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark contiguous mass with sparse white focal spots. Notable high-contrast clusters include a primary spot at approx (x=775, y=590 relative to crop) and several small, high-intensity spots along the trailing edge serrations of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a pixel-calculated interior angle of approximately 50 degrees; depth is significant, extending approximately 15% into the vertical height of the visible lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge. Right lobe exhibits high-amplitude 'teeth' (peaks of 10-15 pixels) with irregular spacing. Left lobe shows a more rhythmic, lower-amplitude sawtooth pattern.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the distal tips toward the median notch; the outer distal margins exhibit a steep convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several circular high-contrast pixel clusters visible; one distinct white spot on the lower mid-section of the right lobe and multiple smaller clusters localized on the peaks of the trailing edge serrations.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of multiple vertical, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (pale grey/white rake marks) visible on the right lobe's medial surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The right distal tip exhibits an irregular, jagged profile with localized white scarring/pigmentation, suggesting historical tissue loss or extreme wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive 'step-like' serration pattern on the inner-trailing edge of the right lobe, featuring deep, narrow valleys between large pixel-peaks.
